{
 "cwd": "/workspace",
 "query": "Build a premium static editorial blog website for an independent publishing studio called NORTHLINE REVIEW. Use only vanilla HTML, CSS and JavaScript, no backend, no database, no login, no external APIs. The site should feel like a Swiss editorial magazine / design journal, inspired by clean Dribbble publishing layouts: strict grid, bold typography, lots of white space, sharp hierarchy, monochrome base with one accent color, very polished and responsive.

PROJECT GOAL
Create a complete front-end static website for a modern online publication covering design, architecture, culture, books, photography and urban life. It should look like a real serious publication, not a generic blog template. Use mock/static/sample content and placeholder images from local/remote static image URLs if needed.

TECH REQUIREMENTS
- Vanilla HTML + CSS + JavaScript only
- Static website, can open in browser without backend
- Fully responsive desktop / tablet / mobile
- No React, no Vue, no backend, no CMS, no auth
- Use semantic HTML
- Clean CSS architecture with variables
- Smooth but subtle transitions
- Must include skeleton loading states using JavaScript for article cards and featured sections, like the page shows grey placeholders first then reveals mock content after a short delay

VISUAL STYLE
- Swiss grid editorial layout
- White / off-white background, black text, light grey borders
- Accent color: deep red or cobalt blue, used sparingly
- Typography: large serif or strong editorial headline mixed with clean sans-serif body text, use Google Fonts if wanted but safe fallback is ok
- Layout should feel like a high-end magazine: asymmetric hero, narrow metadata columns, strong rule lines, numbered sections, editorial tags
- No childish gradients, no neon, no glassmorphism, no cartoon icons
- Use high-quality placeholder editorial imagery: architecture, books, city streets, photography, design objects
- Cards should be clean, rectangular, image-first or typography-first, not rounded bubbly cards

PAGES / SECTIONS REQUIRED
1. Header / Navigation
- NORTHLINE REVIEW wordmark on left
- nav links: Latest, Essays, Culture, Design, Archive, About
- search icon or simple search button on right (static interaction only, can open small search overlay with mock suggestions)
- mobile hamburger menu that works
- sticky header with thin border

2. Home / Front Page
Hero must include:
- Large editorial headline: “The Shape of Quiet Cities”
- category label, issue number, author, date, reading time
- large hero image
- short excerpt
- CTA text link: Read Feature
- side column titled “In This Issue” with 4 short article links

3. Breaking / Latest Strip
- horizontal strip below hero with 5 latest headlines
- each has category + time label
- should scroll nicely on mobile

4. Featured Articles Grid
- At least 6 article cards
- cards with image, category, title, excerpt, author/date
- use skeleton loading: before content appears, show animated grey rectangles for image/title/meta/excerpt, then replace with mock content
- layout should be masonry-like or editorial grid, not all cards identical

5. Longform Essay Highlight
- full-width band with huge quote typography
- article title: “Against the Infinite Feed”
- two-column layout with a pull quote and a short abstract
- button/link: Read Essay

6. Categories Section
Create category blocks for:
- Design
- Architecture
- Literature
- Photography
- Cities
- Opinion
Each block should show count, short description, and one highlighted article title.

7. Archive Section
- table-style list of articles, like a publishing archive
- columns: Date, Category, Title, Author
- at least 10 rows
- on mobile it should transform into stacked rows but remain readable

8. Newsletter Section
- editorial newsletter signup visual only, no real submit
- email input and subscribe button
- on submit show inline message: “Preview subscription saved locally for demo.” or similar
- no backend

9. Article Page Mock Section / Modal / View
Since it is static, include a featured article reading view either as a separate section or a JS-powered overlay when clicking Read Feature:
- article title
- dek/subtitle
- author block
- large image
- body content with at least 5 paragraphs
- pull quote
- related articles
- close/back button if using overlay

10. Footer
- wordmark
- short publication description
- links grouped under Sections, Company, Social
- issue number and copyright

INTERACTIONS
- Skeleton loading for featured content and latest cards on page load
- Mobile navigation open/close
- Search overlay with static suggestions and filtering from mock article titles if easy
- Newsletter fake submit message
- Article overlay or article view open/close for selected mock article
- Hover states for article cards and text links
- Respect reduced motion if possible

CONTENT TONE
Use realistic editorial copy, not lorem ipsum. Article titles should sound like real magazine headlines. Examples style but create your own:
- “A Map of Rooms We No Longer Use”
- “Why Small Publishers Still Matter”
- “The Museum After Closing Time”
- “Notes on Civic Silence”
- “Paper, Memory, and the Slow Web”

IMPORTANT POLISH
- Must look complete above the fold immediately
- Text must never overlap on mobile
- Header must not cover content
- Images should keep stable aspect ratios
- Skeleton loaders must not shift layout when content appears
- Use clean spacing scale and visible grid rhythm
- Make it feel like a real static editorial publishing website ready for a Dribbble shot, but fully usable in browser.",
 "judge": {
  "model": "meta-llama/Llama-4-Maverick-17B-128E-Instruct-FP8",
  "model_sha": "94125d2bd83076b21eed33119525e29eaf3894f4",
  "request_model": "meta-llama/Llama-4-Maverick-17B-128E-Instruct-FP8:novita",
  "provider": "novita",
  "pinned_on": "2026-10-09",
  "temperature": 0,
  "max_tokens": 1024,
  "rubric_id": "rva1:mean(visual,query,asset)"
 }
}

"""Grade a Webdev task as the explorer does (verl recipes/design webdev-eval): render, shrink, judge.

No index.html in dist/ scores 0. A render that fails, or a judge that never answers, writes no reward (not scored):
neither says anything about the page."""
import base64
import io
import json
import os
import random
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, "/tests")
os.environ["WEBDEV_GRADE_HTTP"] = "1"   # serve over loopback http so React/Vue/ES-module sites actually run
from webdev.eval_rubric import build_prompt  # noqa: E402
from webdev.shot import _build_shot_cmd, _parse_render_env, _parse_shot_b64  # noqa: E402
from webdev.verdict import parse_verdict  # noqa: E402

cfg = json.loads(Path("/tests/grade.json").read_text())
V = Path("/logs/verifier")
V.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
dist = Path(cfg["cwd"]) / "dist"


def done(reward: float | None, why: str, **extra) -> None:
    (V / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps({"reward": reward, "summary": why, **extra}, indent=1))
    print(why)
    if reward is None:
        print("not scored", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    (V / "reward.txt").write_text(f"{reward}\n")
    sys.exit(0)


files = sorted(str(p.relative_to(dist)) for p in dist.rglob("*") if p.is_file())[:200] if dist.is_dir() else []
if "index.html" not in files:
    done(0.0, "The agent delivered nothing to dist/." if not files else "dist/ has no index.html, so there is no page to open.",
         delivered=files)
res = subprocess.run(["sh", "-c", _build_shot_cmd(f"file://{dist}/index.html")], capture_output=True, text=True,
                     timeout=150)   # SHOT_TIMEOUT_S
shot = {"output": (res.stdout or "") + "\n" + (res.stderr or "")}
shot_b64, console_errors = _parse_shot_b64(shot)
render_env = _parse_render_env(shot)
if render_env.get("proxy_failed") or not shot_b64:
    print(shot["output"][-2000:], file=sys.stderr)
    done(None, "external assets were unreachable on every route" if render_env.get("proxy_failed")
         else "the screenshot produced no image")
jpg = base64.b64decode(shot_b64)
try:   # eval_mode._shrink: the judge refuses shots over 20 MP; proportional, quality 75
    from PIL import Image
    Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS = None
    im = Image.open(io.BytesIO(jpg))
    size = im.size
    if im.width * im.height > 20e6:
        k = (20e6 / (im.width * im.height)) ** 0.5
        im = im.convert("RGB").resize((max(1, int(im.width * k)), max(1, int(im.height * k))), Image.LANCZOS)
        b = io.BytesIO(); im.save(b, "JPEG", quality=75); jpg = b.getvalue(); size = im.size
except ImportError:
    size = None
(V / "screenshot.jpg").write_bytes(jpg)
content = [{"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": "data:image/jpeg;base64," + base64.b64encode(jpg).decode()}},
           {"type": "text", "text": build_prompt().format(query=cfg["query"][:1500])}]   # QUERY_CAP
url = os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_URL", "https://router.huggingface.co/v1").rstrip("/") + "/chat/completions"
_judge_pin = cfg["judge"]
if os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_REVISION") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
    done(None, "Judge deployment revision is unbound; not scored.")
(V / "judge_config.json").write_text(json.dumps(_judge_pin, indent=1))
body = json.dumps({"model": cfg["judge"]["request_model"], "temperature": 0, "max_tokens": 1024,  # webdev-temp0-pin@1
                   "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": content}]}).encode()
verdict, last = None, ""
for attempt in range(4):   # JUDGE_RETRIES, with eval_mode's backoff
    if attempt:
        time.sleep(min(60.0, 3.0 * (3 ** (attempt - 1))) * (0.5 + random.random()))
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, method="POST", headers={
            "Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ.get('WEBDEV_JUDGE_KEY', '')}"})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=180) as r:   # JUDGE_TIMEOUT_S
            _judge_reply = json.loads(r.read())
            if _judge_reply.get("model_revision") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
                done(None, "Judge response revision differs from the task pin; not scored.")
            msg = _judge_reply["choices"][0]["message"]
        v = parse_verdict(msg.get("content") or msg.get("reasoning_content") or "")
        if "_failed" not in v:
            verdict = v
            break
        last = v["_failed"]
    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
        last = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"[:200]
if not verdict:
    done(None, f"judge unavailable: {last}")
done(verdict["score"], verdict.get("reason", ""), dims=verdict["dims"], visual=verdict["visual"], screenshot_size=size,
     console_errors=console_errors[:1500] if console_errors not in ("", "[]") else "")

rationale: Use temperature zero and bind the model/provider request and artifact revision; mask absent or mismatched deployment/response revision. Version-aware judge endpoint validation is staged.
